q: Which part of a skill is always in the agent’s context?
explain: Everything else loads only when the task needs it.

q: When a skill runs a script, what enters the context?
explain: Code runs in the environment; only output is read.

q: What is the main security risk of installing a third-party skill?
options: It contains instructions the agent will follow and scripts it may run
explain: Review skills like code and pin versions.
